name: gerund-loading-label
title: Gerund Loading Label
description: Loading states as real gerunds: “Validating…”, “Compiling…”, “Installing…” — the label swaps at random-ish intervals with a typing underline that grows like a progress sense, and a final past-tense completion flip.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Async State Machine: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
